title: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Polymorphism and Acute Renal Failure (ECAREA)
brief_summary: Associations between angiotensin-converting enzyme gene polymorphism and occurrence and outcome of ARDS, and with respiratory complications post cardiopulmonary bypass have already been demonstrated. Based on physiological effects of angiotensin II, we hypothesized that the I allele of the angiotensin-converting enzyme Insertion/Deletion polymorphism may be associated with a higher risk of acute renal failure in critically ill patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 yrs
* ICU stay \> 48 hours

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 yrs
* Creatinine \> 180 µmol/L
* Absence of consent
study_population: Consecutive patients admitted to ICU fore more than 48 hours
